What is a forex partner program?

A forex partner program pays you for
introducing traders to a broker. At TMGM
there are four ways to do it: refer traders
you know as an Introducing Broker, send
traffic as an Affiliate, create content as
an Influencer, or combine upfront CPA
and rebates with Hybrid. Pick the one
that fits how you already work.

It depends on how you work. If you know traders personally, the Introducing Broker program fits. If you run a site, ads or channels, choose the Affiliate Program. If you create content, the Influencer Partnership Program is built for you. Hybrid suits partners who want upfront CPA and ongoing rebates together. Your partnership manager can help you decide.

Affiliates reach audiences online through traffic, content, advertising and followers, and the relationship with the trader is usually brief: they arrive through your link and become TMGM's client. Introducing Brokers work through relationships they already have, often locally, and tend to stay involved with the clients they introduce, earning on trading volume rather than a one-time commission.

Yes. Pick the program that fits how you work today, and change lanes as you grow. Talk to your partnership manager when your business changes.

Nothing. Applying is free and carries no obligation. Applications are subject to approval.

It depends on your program. Introducing Brokers are paid daily. Affiliates are paid monthly. Influencer fees are paid in stages through the campaign, starting with 50% when the agreement is signed. Hybrid combines upfront CPA with rebates on your clients' trading.

Not always. Availability depends on where you and your clients are based, and the Hybrid Program is offered in selected countries only. Your partnership manager confirms what's available to you when you apply.

Yes. Swap-free Islamic accounts are available for clients who require them, alongside Edge, Classic and Cent accounts. Your partnership manager can confirm availability for your clients' region.

It depends on their region. TMGM is one group with four regulated entities, regulated by ASIC, VFSC, FSA and FSC, and clients are onboarded under the entity that fits their region. Your partnership manager confirms it when you join.
